title: Pointwise hitting-probability bound on a chain
statement: For all natural numbers $n$ and $k$ and every vertex $i\in\text{Fin}(n+1)$, consider the digraph on $text{Fin}(n+1)$ with an edge from $u$ to $v$ when $v=0$ or $v=u+1$. The $k$-step probability of hitting the target vertex $n$ when starting at $i$, multiplied by $2^n$, is at most $2^i+k$.
hypotheses_covered: The specified chain digraph and target vertex n.
